subject: Stakeholder clarifications + exec priorities for upcoming QBR
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder clarifications + exec priorities for upcoming QBR

Team — thanks for the focused weekly sync this morning. I captured the things that need explicit follow-ups before Monday's prep review so execs have a clean ask set for the QBR. Please confirm ownership and estimated completion times in-thread. Key items below (short):

1) Exec ask: prioritize a targeted latency improvement for the hosted Redis cache fallback path (affects Borealis POC). Owner: Ben. ETA requested: EOD Wed (26 May).
2) Roadmap exception: add a scoped rollout for the KV cache hot-key mitigation (will change rollout plan). Owner: Lauren — need a 1-paragraph rationale for execs. ETA: Thu COB.
3) Procurement gating: Borealis procurement requires a signed MSA + action plan before next billing cycle. Owner: Marissa to coordinate (they want a document + vendor contact). ETA: Fri.
4) QBR deck: consolidate one slide with outcome metrics and the fallback mitigation plan. Owner: Jonas will draft the slide; need numbers from Ben and notes from Lauren by Thu noon.

Attachments: QBR-deck-v1.pdf (draft outline)

Small ask: if any items are blocked (legal, compliance, or infra capacity), call it out now so we can escalate.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder clarifications + exec priorities for upcoming QBR

Jonas — thanks, adding status inline.

1) KV cache hot-key mitigation (roadmap exception): I agree we should surface the exception. Rationale (draft): this is a short-term tactical change to routing to reduce tail latency for small-batch inference in US region; it avoids a full model variant rollout and preserves throughput for existing Dedicated customers. I will refine to one paragraph and push by Thu COB.

2) For the slide: I'll include the brief risk/opportunity bullets and the deployment timeline (canary -> 25% -> 100%). Need Ben's SLO numbers to quantify expected tail reduction.

Blockers: None on my side; infra needs a confirmed canary window (Ben).

Quick update on the latency SLOs and the canary window:

- Baseline 95th p50/p95/p99 for affected endpoints (hosted fallback): 45ms / 190ms / 420ms. Goal is to reduce p95 by ~40ms for the Borealis POC under small-batch traffic.
- Proposed canary window: May 27 00:00 - May 28 23:59 PT (48h) — infra says we have capacity for a light canary at 25% traffic.
- Risk: If the hot-key mitigation requires a model variant fallback, token cost could increase ~8–12% in the worst case. We should put that note on the slide.

I attached a small table with the SLOs I referenced. Will be available to review the deck Thu morning.

Attachments: latency-slo-table.csv

Ben
Ben Carter
Staff SWE (Serving Runtime) | Redwood Inference

Closing loop from the PM side — final status and outstanding items: 

- KV cache rationale: DONE (one-paragraph rationale below).
  Rationale: Short-term routing change to limit hot-key amplification in small-batch requests; expected to lower p95 tail latency without a full model variant rollout.
- Ben confirmed canary window (May 27–28) and p95 target: reduce p95 by 40ms.
- Marissa: MAP received; procurement confirmed they will start review Wed morning and expect a signed MSA by the following week if there are no material redlines.
- QBR slide: Jonas, I uploaded my notes and the rationale into the shared Drive folder and incorporated the risk/cost bullet (cost +8–12% worst-case).

Open items (owners):
- Deck visual polish (Jonas) — Thu morning
- Final legal signoff on MSA (Legal) — next week
- Post-canary monitoring runbook update (Ben) — after canary completes (owner to close)

If no objections, I'll mark the exec ask as "prep complete" and move slide to the QBR final deck.

Lauren Bishop
Senior PM | Redwood Inference
